basic_info.description: She strutted onto the scene as a model home, and she still knows how to work her angles in the sunlight. All she needs is a more current style and she'll once again be the queen of the block. She is 3250 Moraga, a 2 bed/1 bath (+ bonus room and bath) mid-century beauty in the Outer Sunset, and she's waiting to meet you.    Mature rosebushes stud the perimeter of this corner lot. A tunnel entry rises to the front door. Inside, find the skylit kitchen at the heart of the home. It flows to the formal dining room and adjacent living room at the front, where west-facing windows frame ocean views and golden sunsets. 2 rear bedrooms overlook the yard and feature generous closets. A linen closet and hall bath complete this level. Internal stairs lead to a bonus room with full bathroom. This level also features a garage with abundant storage, a laundry area with sink, and space to expand the home, plus access to the paved backyard. Park 1 car in the garage and another in the driveway. This "Very Walkable + Bikeable" location, per WalkScore.com, is just 3 blocks from Muni's N Judah line. Shops, dining, and schools are also nearby. Henry Doelger made her the showcase of his "Clinton" style. Her longtime stewards cherished her for over 50 years. How will you write 3250 Moraga's next chapter?
